{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
dup_count = duplicate_patients.sum()

dup_info = df[duplicate_patients]

# Check the sample_seq for duplicates
max_sample_seq_per_patient = dup_info.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()

# Confirm all duplicates have different sample_seq
all_different_seq = (dup_info.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique() == 2).all()

# Print summary
print(f'Duplicate patient count: {dup_count}')
dup_info.head()"}
